verdict.rationale: Meltano explicitly documents that projects are code-based and can be treated like any software project with version control, code review, and CI/CD (meltano-docs-18), and plugin/config changes are idempotent and testable (meltano-docs-24, meltano-docs-9), which supports versioning and review of automations. However, there is no explicit first-party feature or documentation for 'rollback' beyond implied git-based reversion, and no independent/community corroboration of this workflow in practice. Missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism/documentation, independent hands-on evidence of version/review/rollback workflow.
